title: 32 km inversion, 20 TAO iterations under scpc_gamg with SEP2 sub-element friction and five-solve evaluations on PR 155's head: a new paused solver every taped solve
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=1 (five annotated solves an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; ran about 09:45 to 10:20, beside another session's 8-rank 4 km inversions, 4-rank 32 km runs and its serial test suite (load up to 69), so its seconds are contended (test-32km-inversion-reuse-tao-before-rerun times the same comparison on a quiet machine); work counts, objectives and RSS do not depend on it
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1034 MiB after the first taped solve, 1612 MiB after the last; peak 1729 MiB
code: 4cf7f0e (PR 155 head, a git archive); icepack_tools e7b923e
cost: 2191 s for 20 iterations (22 evaluations): 98.8 s an evaluation (median after the first); 110 taped solves 1860 s; 356 NonlinearVariationalSolver builds (34 s) and 132 SCPC setups (36 s)
audit: objective 7.849914e4 to 2.120453e4, as test-32km-inversion-subelement-scpc-gamg; 10.0 Newton iterations and 195 V-cycles a condensed solve; published residual 57.9 after a 0-iteration final solve; no forward failed
notes: ISMIP7_SUBELEMENT_FRICTION=1 (exact front push on) ISMIP7_GRAD_PRECOND=mass_consistent ISMIP7_PRIOR_FORM=bilaplacian; the configuration of test-32km-inversion-subelement-scpc-gamg; run under a probe wrapper (scratch, not tracked) that times solver construction, SCPC setup and each taped solve and logs each rank's RSS after every taped solve; it changes nothing the driver computes
